title: rekey forced removal leaves removed admin in admins[] retaining admin role forever
description: File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py:251-255. Strips removed_member from members[]+invitations only; requester_role checks admins FIRST (:383-389) so removed admin keeps GET-roster rights via _roster_view_authorized(:410-415). Repro'd: promote BADADMIN, rekey(removed_member=BADADMIN) -> members=['OWNER'] admins=['BADADMIN'] role=admin. Spec 18.8.2 forced removal MUST fully demote; violates gyfo matrix + yuvj wall; no test exercises admin removal. Fix: strip from admins too + demotion test.
close_reason: Verified fixed + tested: rekey(removed_member) strips admins[] alongside members[]/invitations (groups_collection.py), requester_role fail-closed requires members AND admins, _join_key FORBIDDENs without live invitation. Full demotion test with post-removal roster-access denial exists and passes: test_groups_rekey.py::test_rekey_removes_admin_from_authoritative_roster (promotion -> rekey -> admin gone from both lists, requester_role None, GET /members 4.03, owner view clean).
